$comment: What each synthetic fixture must do. Owner-recorded clips are listed under `recorded`, by sha256, once they exist (RECORDING.md); none is committed.

hls-as-mp4.note: Not a video by its bytes: FFmpeg never sees it.

concat-list.note: Not a video by its bytes: FFmpeg never sees it.

sdp.note: Not a video by its bytes: FFmpeg never sees it.

text-as-mp4.note: Not a video by its bytes: FFmpeg never sees it.

empty.note: Not a video by its bytes: FFmpeg never sees it.

polyglot-gif-zip.note: A GIF with a ZIP trailer: read as the GIF it starts as.

truncated-moov.note: Half a moov: FFmpeg refuses it, nothing is killed.

moov-external-ref.note: Its first track's dref entry made external, naming file:///etc/passwd: FFmpeg 9.0.2 never opens a url-entry's location and reads the samples from the file itself; the confinement would deny the read in any case.

16k-frame.note: 16384×1088 is past -max_pixels (4096×4096): refused before a frame is decoded.

10h-one-frame.note: Ten hours by its timestamps: the probe answers, then it is refused as too long.

1e6-tiny-frames.note: A million 16×16 frames, 1,000 s: refused as too long after the probe.

huge-moov.note: 250,000 sample entries: probed within its clock and caps.

fuzzed-0.note: Seeded bit flips past the ftyp: an answer, FFmpeg's refusal, or a kill within caps, never the owner's crash.
